name: KKE Cleaning Services
heading: A clearer route to a quote.
intro: A responsive service website concept for a cleaning company, organised around service scope, project examples and quotation enquiries.
note: The Services page puts the category index beside the selected service and its enquiry action. On mobile, those elements follow one another in the reading order.
brief: Help visitors understand which cleaning service fits their space and give them a clear route to request a quote.
decisions: The Services mock-up pairs a category index with the selected service. The enquiry action sits near the scope so visitors can decide what to ask for.
On desktop, related content and contact information can sit side by side. On mobile, service details and the quotation form follow a single reading order.
reflection: The wireframe established the page order. The colour mock-up sharpened the opening message and made the enquiry paths more visible. The workbook identifies consistent imagery and service labels across breakpoints as the next refinement.

name: ARTStronomy
heading: An exhibition with two ways in.
intro: A collaborative digital exhibition that brings student artwork and astronomy into the same web experience.
note: The landing page gives visitors a direct route to creators and exhibition information, with a separate entry into the interactive world.
brief: Create a web entry point for the exhibition that supports both finding artwork quickly and exploring its astronomy theme.
decisions: Exhibition information and creator browsing give visitors a straightforward way to find work from the main site.
The constellation quiz and interactive world offer optional ways to engage with the exhibition. The landing page can introduce those experiences while still orienting first-time visitors.
reflection: This was a team project, and my contribution is credited under Web Design. The homepage capture documents the exhibition entry. I would next test how easily first-time visitors find the creator list and recognise the interactive entry.

name: AbangBoy
heading: A showcase for the work behind the brand.
intro: A WordPress showcase for an influencer’s services, brand collaborations and featured content.
note: Separate sections give services, collaborations and featured content their own place. The opening introduces the offer before visitors explore the examples.
brief: Build a site that gives prospective collaborators a single place to understand the offer and see examples of the work.
decisions: Give each content type a home
I built and edited the page layouts in Elementor, grouping the service offering, brand collaborations and featured content in separate sections.
The opening pairs a short statement of the brand’s offer with campaign imagery and clear actions. Supporting content follows further down the page.
reflection: The capture shows the page hierarchy and Elementor implementation. A next step would be to check how easily a prospective collaborator can move from a featured example to the relevant service or contact action.
